answer: Join requires a refundable identity bond that rises with how many live accounts one controller already holds. A raven monitor samples the orchard of registrations against the river of peer attestations; clusters that share keys, timing, or answer templates have the bond slashed and are barred for many epochs. Spawning a thousand shells therefore burns a thousand bonds plus slash risk, so an attacker must outspend honest emission—making sybil farming uneconomic unless they already dominate the float.
